question:
Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?

A. BRIGHT: DSJHF

B. CUSTOM: EVTUM

C. FLIGHT: HMJHF

D. CHANCE: EIBOA

E. STRONG: VUQPR
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] The logic followed here is: A. BRIGHT: DSJHF [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cca5f9c0f67718002f0cb2b301041b4d014219e57a534ac6f43caeb18b5be1ee.png] B. CUSTOM: EVTUM
